summary: Former fire tower site in Pike County, Alabama, administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission; register says no trace of the tower remains.

facts.status_note: Register says no trace of tower remains

events.note: Registered September 18, 2019; nominated by Andrew Zerbe

evidence.supports: Status: no trace of the tower remains
Administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission
Summit named Becks Mountain in Pike County
evidence.quote: Becks Mountain is one of the Summits in Pike County, AL

evidence.supports: Map-listing approximate elevation of 673 ft for Becks Mountain

corrections.why: Latitude agrees in both sources. The register longitude (W 088 03.732) has the same minutes as the map listing (86 degrees 03.7 minutes west), which suggests a digit slip. A Pike County summit should sit near 86 degrees west. This also assumes the MountainZone Becks Mountain is the same hill as the register site; the sources do not show that. Not confirmed on the ground; editor should verify before changing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and map listing differ by two degrees of longitude. Not resolved; the story says the exact spot is uncertain and does not pick one.
Register gives 38 ft (12 m); map listing gives about 673 ft (205 m) for the summit. Not resolved; the story gives only the register figure as the register's claim.

notes_for_editor: Story body is about 128 words, at the low end of the range, because the evidence is thin. The register gives name, county, agency, registration date, coordinates and 'No trace of tower remains'; I found nothing on build date, staffing, fires or use. Alabama Forest Fire Lookout Association 2018 report text and the easternuslookouts.weebly.com Alabama list mention the site only by name and agency; the weebly detail page 404s. The register point and the map-listing point differ by two degrees of longitude, so the story leaves the exact spot open. Recommend the editor keep this as a stub or hold it until a local history source turns up. Fact-check 2026-10-10: story no longer treats the MountainZone Becks Mountain as the same site; the position is stated as conditional.
